_meta.notes: T06 damage pipeline: weather, tool (accepted, unused MVP), scripted herbivore swarms and terrain collapse/debris. Roots are not a damage source (ADR-051). Drops and kill credit are tuned here; fragment item rules stay with T51 in fragments.json.

weather_damage_per_s.notes: Structural damage per second to a plant exposed to an active thunderstorm. 1.2/s killed a young plant inside one storm; a storm should cost tissue and force repair, not end the run before the reroot game is even reachable.

weather_min_biomass.notes: Structural biomass a plant needs before a storm's absolute damage applies. Below it the plant is small enough to shrug the weather off; without a floor a freshly germinated sprout died inside one storm tick.

weather_max_biomass_fraction_per_s.notes: Ceiling on storm damage as a share of the plant's own biomass per second. 0.008/s is about a quarter of the plant gone across a full storm, which is a wound, not a death sentence.

lightning_max_biomass_fraction.notes: A strike can never take more than this share of the plant's biomass, so it hurts a young plant instead of executing it.

storm_gust_speed_mps.notes: Gust a plant catches during the active thunderstorm phase. Compared against the uproot threshold after height scaling.

lightning_damage_amount.notes: One-off structural damage of a lightning strike inside the weather lightning radius. 18 could take a whole young plant in one unlucky hit; a strike should be memorable, not an execution.

herbivore_swarm_auto_enabled.notes: Automatic swarms are off until T54 renders fauna. An invisible swarm that damages every plant near spawn is not a fair hazard; dev_herbivore_swarm still forces one.

herbivore_swarm_interval_s.notes: How often a scripted swarm passes through the region. Swarms are events, not pathfinding agents.

herbivore_swarm_radius_m.notes: Radius of the swarm's browse area.

herbivore_swarm_duration_s.notes: Seconds the swarm keeps browsing before it moves on.

herbivore_swarm_damage_per_s.notes: Browse damage per second to every plant inside the swarm radius.

herbivore_swarm_spread_m.notes: Half-width of the region a swarm centre may appear in around the world origin.

tool_damage_per_hit.notes: Damage an accepted tool hit would deal. The source is wired into the pipeline; no tool verb ships in the MVP.

terrain_collapse_damage.notes: Damage a collapsing void deals to a plant whose root plate sits inside terrain_collapse_radius_m.

terrain_collapse_radius_m.notes: Distance from a collapse at which it still rattles the plant.

damage_memory_decay_per_s.notes: Unhealed structural damage forgotten per second. Crossing uproot.damage_threshold_hp before it decays tears the plant out.

fragment_drop_chance.notes: Chance that a node destroyed by damage leaves a fragment. T51 turns the drop into an item.

remains_fragment_count.notes: Fragments left where a plant died.

fragment_lifetime_s.notes: How long a dropped fragment stays in the world before it decays.

dung_per_death.notes: Dung left by a dying plant.

dung_per_swarm.notes: Dung a swarm leaves when it moves on.

dung_lifetime_s.notes: How long dung stays in the world before it decays.

kill_credit_window_s.notes: Damage older than this is not counted when the killing blow is credited to a player source.
